title: Replace chlorine with nitrogen
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Ammonia reacts with an acid chloride by nucleophilic acyl substitution. Chlorine is replaced by an amino group while the carbonyl remains, producing ethanamide.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of ethanoyl chloride under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Ethanoyl chloride is treated with excess ammonia. Which major organic product forms after workup? Ammonia reacts with an acid chloride by nucleophilic acyl substitution. Chlorine is replaced by an amino group while the carbonyl remains, producing ethanamide.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
